fact_no_result_all: No provider has a result in any of these benchmarks yet.
fact_no_result_one: No provider has a result in this benchmark yet.
fact_no_result_two: No provider has a result in either benchmark yet.
fact_no_result_many: No provider has a result in any of the {count} benchmarks yet.
fact_no_exact_cost_one: No provider has an exact provider-sourced cost on this benchmark yet.
fact_no_exact_cost_two: No provider has an exact provider-sourced cost on both benchmarks yet.
fact_no_exact_cost: No provider has an exact provider-sourced cost on all {count} benchmarks yet.
fact_no_result_time: No successful trial. Substituted with the slowest {statistic} from the providers that completed this {unit}.
fact_no_result_cost: No successful trial. Substituted with the highest {statistic} cost from the providers that completed this {unit}.
fact_fill_time_rule: For each missing workload, this composite uses the slowest {statistic} time any provider recorded on that workload.
fact_fill_cost_rule: For each missing workload, this composite uses the highest {statistic} cost any provider recorded on that workload.
fact_score_definition: Each {unit} scores 100 × the best provider's {statistic} ÷ this provider's {statistic}; one without a result adds no points.
fact_score_missing_unit: A missing {unit} adds no points to the score.
fact_cost_split_rule: Each stage's cost is the shown cost times that stage's share of the Time bar under the same statistic.
fact_fill_unit_time_rule: For each missing {unit}, this workload uses the slowest {statistic} time any provider recorded on that {unit}.
fact_fill_unit_cost_rule: For each missing {unit}, this workload uses the highest {statistic} cost any provider recorded on that {unit}.
